question: In the passage, what is the closest meaning of the word "superseded"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)** i.e. **Replaced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"superseded"** means to take the place of a person or thing previously in authority or use; to cause to be set aside in favor of something newer or better. (जगह लेना या अधिक्रमण करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The old regulations were superseded by the new safety standards introduced last month.
 
 
 
• **"Replaced" **refers to the act of putting something new in the place of something else, which is the direct synonym for superseded in professional and technical contexts. (बदला हुआ या प्रतिस्थापित)
 
 
• **Example: **The manual typewriter was eventually replaced by the word processor in most offices.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- **Replaced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Upgraded **(उन्नत): To raise something to a higher standard or improve its quality, often within the same system.

 
 
• **Example:** I upgraded my computer's RAM to make the video editing software run faster.
 
 
 
• **Abandoned **(छोड़ा हुआ ): Having been deserted or left permanently; given up completely.
 
 
• **Example: **The project was abandoned due to a lack of funding and interest from stakeholders.
 
 
 
• **Destroyed** (नष्ट): Damaged so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired.
 
 
• **Example:** The historical documents were unfortunately destroyed in the office fire.
